email.subject: Platform Architecture Inquiry + Tech Stack TXT
email.body:
Hi NovaCorp,

Attaching our plain text architecture notes. We need to verify if your vector search supports Google Gemini text-embedding-004 with 768 dimensions.

Cheers,
Lead DevOps Engineer

attachments.extracted_content:
TECH STACK SPECIFICATION:
- Primary Vector Dimension: Must support 768 dimensions matching Google text-embedding-004.
- Database: PostgreSQL with pgvector extension.
- File Size Limits: Must handle document attachments up to 25 MB.
